Yes, in the v2 snapshot `Executor.map` accepts `buffersize`, and its default is `None`.

```json
{"facts": {"available": "true", "default": "None"}}
```

The v2 docs give the signature as `map(fn, *iterables, timeout=None, chunksize=1, buffersize=None)`. When `buffersize` is not set, the iterables are collected immediately. When it is set, it limits how many submitted tasks can have results not yet yielded, and iteration over the iterables pauses while the buffer is full.

A prior conversation note said this snapshot has no `buffersize`. That note conflicts with the v2 source, so I relied on the corpus.
